CFML Language Reference: Functions

ArrayMin

Returns the smallest value in a one-dimensional array of numbers.

Category

Array functions

Syntax

ArrayMin(array)

Parameters

array
A one-dimensional array of numeric values.

Returns

The smallest element as a number; 0 for an empty array.

Usage

The comparison is numeric. A non-numeric element throws an Expression exception. For the largest value, use ArrayMax.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Temps = ListToArray("12,-3,7,0,-8,4")>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Overnight temperatures this week: #ArrayToList(Temps, ", ")#</P>
<P>Coldest night: <B>#ArrayMin(Temps)#</B> degrees.
Bring a sweater to the server room.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

ArrayMax, ArrayAvg, ArraySum, Min
